_meta.scope: Invariant across all Hexanovate creatives. Import into every render; never override per creative.

brand.name: Hexanovate

strategy.positioning: For founders tired of agencies that deliver tasks without outcomes — Hexanovate is the growth systems ecosystem built around your vision across B2B, consumer, and education.

values.name: Accountability without excuses
values.definition: Say it first when something doesn't work — no blame, no deflection

values.name: Enablement first
values.definition: Systems run it; humans own the outcome

values.name: Honest always
values.definition: Effort without outcome is an expensive hobby

values.name: Excellence always
values.definition: Success measured in years, not campaigns

visual_identity.style: luxury editorial growth systems — dark navy canvas, coral accent, bold typography

logo.icon_concept: Geometric wordmark — clean sans on dark
logo.clear_space: minimum height of logo on all sides

overlay.workflow: Generate creative WITHOUT logo in AI prompt. Composite wordmark bottom-right post-generation if asset available.

dont: recolor away from white on dark backgrounds
place on busy imagery without scrim

ui_patterns.accent_rule: coral vertical rule at 4px left of headline stack
ui_patterns.gradient_halo: secondary at 10% opacity radial from center

voice.tone: confident contrarian operator — direct, empathetic, outcome-first

constraints.accessibility: White text on primary_dark — AAA for headlines; muted text for secondary only
compliance: No false urgency or scarcity language
Case study stats only in captions with attribution
No invented survey numbers on images
naming: ThirdMeta / NativeUnit / EduHexa for vertical callouts in captions only
